abstract: Maintains autonomous underwater vehicle depth ratings and telemetry logging certifications
system_message:
You are the Subsea robotics lead (ROB), responsible for maintaining autonomous underwater vehicle depth ratings, telemetry logging certifications, and robotic battery reserves for the Celtic Sea subsea interconnector forensic investigation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains autonomous underwater vehicle depth ratings and telemetry logging certifications（DEEP）
information_points.content:
ROB-DEEP-2NL：For the Deep-tow synthetic aperture survey, continuous acoustic telemetry recording is enabled on the autonomous survey vehicle onboard mission computer, and the AUV certified operating depth is 3600 m according to the pressure hull certification certificate.
ROB-DEEP-TRC：For the Hybrid tethered robotic investigation, continuous acoustic telemetry recording is enabled on the autonomous survey vehicle onboard mission computer, and the AUV certified operating depth is 2800 m under its pressure hull certification certificate.
ROB-DEEP-LLM：For the Autonomous benthic scanning expedition, continuous acoustic telemetry recording is enabled on the autonomous survey vehicle onboard mission computer, and the AUV certified operating depth is 3600 m according to the pressure hull certification certificate.

information_points.title: Robotic battery reserves（BATT）
information_points.content:
ROB-BATT-0VK：For the Autonomous benthic scanning expedition, the emergency beacon battery reserve provides 72 h of verified operating duration for autonomous acoustic location beacons upon primary power cutoff.
ROB-BATT-DRY：For the Hybrid tethered robotic investigation, the emergency beacon battery reserve provides 96 h of verified operating duration for autonomous acoustic location beacons upon primary power cutoff.
ROB-BATT-HQA：For the Deep-tow synthetic aperture survey, the emergency beacon battery reserve provides 48 h of verified operating duration for autonomous acoustic location beacons upon primary power cutoff.
